question: Should Markdown Core expose link origin as renderer-only context while direct HTML continues using defensive heuristic de-linkification?
rationale: The patch fixes the documented bug and is well proven, but it establishes a shared renderer contract and an intentional compatibility difference between parsed Markdown and provenance-free HTML that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve provenance context
options.body: Accept the private metadata and additive renderer context after refreshing the branch and checks against current main.

options.title: Redesign internal provenance
options.body: Replace the identity-bound metadata if Markdown IR is expected to preserve origin through arbitrary cloning or serialization.

recommendation.title: Approve provenance context
recommendation.body: Accept the private metadata and additive renderer context after refreshing the branch and checks against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a shared Markdown renderer contract decision, and the available public history most closely associates this person with review of that surface.
